versions.localizedDescription:
## AltLoad 1.5.0

### New
- **altpair.** Install AltLoad with your own Apple ID, on the iPhone, with no computer, no DNS profile and no shared certificate. It uses three free App Store apps: rootshell, Open Minis and LocalDevVPN. I wrote it from scratch; the steps are on the [website](https://mirazbakis.github.io/AltLoad/) and the source is in [altpair](https://github.com/mirazbakis/AltLoad/tree/main/altpair).
- **AltStore without AltServer.** After installing AltStore, AltLoad leaves this iPhone's pairing file where AltStore 2.3.1 and later look for it. Open AltStore › Settings › Set up Remote AltServer once, and it skips pairing; from then on AltStore installs and refreshes apps by itself, with AltLoad closed.
- **JIT that stays.** AltLoad now stays with the app while it asks for JIT memory, which emulators need on newer iPhones, and lets go when the app is done.
- **JIT scripts.** A script decides how AltLoad answers the app. AltLoad's own handles the usual requests, apps can send their own, and you can import .js scripts and pick one per app in Tools › JIT › Scripts.
- **JIT from links and Shortcuts.** Other apps can open themselves with JIT through `altload://enable-jit?bundle-id=…`, and Shortcuts has an Enable JIT action. AltLoad asks before it follows a link.
- **Automatic refresh.** AltLoad refreshes apps that expire within two days by itself, when you open it and in the background. If a certificate is revoked, it signs the affected apps again with a new certificate and provisioning profile. It finds revoked certificates through your Apple ID's developer account, not Apple's OCSP servers, which DNS profiles often block. It needs LocalDevVPN on and the Apple ID's password saved; turn it off in Settings › Automatic Refresh.
- **Several Apple IDs.** Save more than one in Settings and switch in the sign-in form. Each app remembers the Apple ID that signed it, so a refresh uses the same one.
- **UTM, MeloNX and Madeira.** Install them from the store list. Madeira gets this iPhone's pairing file for its built-in JIT; UTM and MeloNX get an **Open with JIT** button right after installing.
- **Install time.** The success screen shows how long the install took.

### Changed
- **Faster installs.** The app unpacks while you sign in instead of after.
- **New website.** A cleaner black and white design, with clearer install steps.

altpair, the new JIT sessions, automatic refresh and AltStore's Remote AltServer setup are new and haven't had wide testing yet. If something doesn't work, please open an issue.

## AltLoad 1.4.0

### New
- **Husk.** Install Husk from the store list, with this iPhone's pairing file already inside it for its built-in JIT.
- **French, German, Italian, Chinese and Russian.** AltLoad follows your iPhone's language.
- **Update notices.** AltLoad tells you when a newer version is out.

### Fixed
- **Pairing files for SideStore and SideStore + LiveContainer.** They now include this iPhone's UDID and go everywhere SideStore looks, along with the settings newer builds need.
- **"Apple ID or password incorrect" with Anisette on Automatic.** Apple gives that answer for anisette data it won't accept too, so AltLoad now tries the next server instead of stopping, and keeps your saved password.
- Fixed potential issues with Apple IDs

## AltLoad 1.3.0

### Fixed
- **SideStore no longer asks you to import a pairing file.** AltLoad now hands the pairing file over the way SideStore reads it, on stable and Nightly. If SideStore has already been opened and still asks, restart your iPhone.
- **SideStore + LiveContainer gets the pairing file too.** It's placed for you at install, so there's nothing to import by hand.

### Changed
- **Far fewer Apple ID sign-ins.** AltLoad keeps Apple's developer token after you sign in and reuses it for installs, refreshes and the account screens, so unstable anisette servers and 2FA prompts get in the way less often. Signing out deletes it.
- **Pure black background** with a small navy glow.
- **Cleaner screens.** Pair, Pairing File to Apps and the install results are simpler, and placing a pairing file is now one button.

### Removed
- **Apple TV pairing.** Pairing files you already saved for an Apple TV stay in the list, but they're never used for installs.

## AltLoad 1.2.0

### New
- **Choose what happens to app extensions.** Before installing a store or an IPA, pick **Keep Extensions**, **Keep, Use Main Profile** (the whole app uses one App ID) or **Remove Extensions**, like SideStore. Handy with a free Apple ID's 10 App IDs a week.
- **Pairing code in the Dynamic Island.** While you pair, the six-digit code shows in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, so you can read it while you're in Settings.
- **Import a pairing file.** Tools › Pair › Import Pairing File adds a pairing file made on a computer and uses it for installs.
- **Runs on iOS 18 and later.** Below iOS 27 the iPhone can't pair with AltLoad itself, so the Pair screen walks you through importing a pairing file instead.
- **App IDs in Tools.** See every App ID on your Apple ID, how many of the weekly limit are used, and when each one frees up. Pull down to refresh.
- **Another anisette server.** Automatic now also tries jkcoxson's macOS server, after the Windows one, whenever it's up.

### Changed
- **Your apps are on the Install tab** under Your Apps, with a pill to refresh each one. Library is gone.
- **Every pairing file is on the Pair page.** Long-press one to use it for installs, share it or delete it.
- **Entitlements moved to Tools.**
- **Pairing File to Apps lists only sideloaded apps,** like SideStore and StikDebug.
- **Liquid Glass buttons** and **icons without tiles** throughout the app.

### Good to know
- The Dynamic Island code comes from a small widget extension inside AltLoad. With a free Apple ID, sideloading AltLoad uses **2 App IDs** instead of 1.

## AltLoad 1.0.1

### Fixed
- **AltStore sign-in through AltLoad.** With Settings › Anisette on Automatic (the default), AltStore couldn't get anisette data from AltLoad's AltServer, so signing in inside AltStore failed. AltServer now uses the same working servers as AltLoad and moves on to the next one if a server doesn't answer.

## AltLoad 1.0.0

### New
- **SideStore** and **SideStore + LiveContainer**, each as a stable or **nightly** build. Pick one from the store menu on the Install tab.
- **When SideStore's repository is down**, AltLoad tries a mirror, GitHub releases, a known-good build and its own saved copy. If none answer, pick an IPA from Files.
- **Sign in from Settings.** Settings › Apple ID › Sign In checks your Apple ID, including two-factor, without installing anything.
- **About** tab with special thanks and legal links. Settings now opens from the gear at the top right of every tab.

### Fixed
- **Apple ID sign-in.** Since 12 October 2026 Apple refuses sign-in data from many anisette servers. AltLoad now picks a server that's working, moves on to the next one when Apple refuses it, and keeps its anisette data in files instead of the Keychain (which some signing tools break). Use **Reset Anisette Data** in Settings if sign-in keeps failing.
- Installs sign in to Apple first, so a sign-in problem shows up straight away.

### Changed
- Darker midnight design with a navy spotlight, solid cards and bigger buttons.
- New icon: midnight, dark green and white.
